title: 短板效应可视化
summary: 用木桶水位观察流水线的吞吐上限：调整阶段处理能力，识别共同瓶颈，比较优化前后的收益。
summary_en: Explore a pipeline’s throughput ceiling with a barrel model: adjust stage capacity, identify tied bottlenecks, and compare improvements.

title: Chrome 快捷键速查
summary: Chrome 常用快捷键，按标签页、页面浏览、文本编辑、浏览器功能和地址栏分类，提供 Windows/Linux 与 macOS 对照。
summary_en: Chrome keyboard shortcuts for tabs, navigation, text editing, browser features, and the address bar, with Windows/Linux and macOS side by side.

title: Claude Code 速查
summary: 快捷键、Slash 命令、MCP、配置与工作流参考，支持模糊搜索、平台切换和打印。
summary_en: Keyboard shortcuts, slash commands, MCP, configuration, and workflows, with fuzzy search, platform selection, and printing.

title: Codex 指令速查
summary: 可搜索的 Codex CLI 子命令、Slash 命令和启动参数，附官方文档链接与打印入口。
summary_en: Search Codex CLI subcommands, slash commands, and flags, with official references and print support.

title: Colormap 色图速查
summary: 按连续、发散、定性和循环等类别浏览常用色图的渐变示意。
summary_en: Browse gradient approximations of sequential, diverging, qualitative, and cyclic colormaps.

title: CUPTI 表速查
summary: Nsight Systems SQLite 核心表、字段与关联关系，支持按 CPU、GPU、MIXED 和 META 筛选。
summary_en: Core Nsight Systems SQLite tables, columns, and joins, searchable and filterable by CPU, GPU, MIXED, and META.

title: Matplotlib 速查
summary: Matplotlib 绘图、配色、坐标轴与标注速查，保留 3.5.0 版的紧凑分栏、代码和图例。
summary_en: A compact reference for plots, colors, axes, and annotations, preserving the code and visual examples from the Matplotlib 3.5.0 cheatsheet.

title: NVIDIA GPU 架构速查
summary: NVIDIA GPU 架构、芯片、Compute Capability 和 CUDA 版本的对应关系，以及 Tensor Core 代际和资料索引。
summary_en: NVIDIA architectures, chips, compute capabilities, CUDA support, Tensor Core generations, and source references.

title: Typst 语法速查
summary: 文本、函数、数学公式、表格和页面设置的语法示例，配有效果预览与参数速查。
summary_en: Syntax examples and previews for text, functions, mathematics, tables, page layout, and common parameters.

title: Roofline 性能模型可视化
summary: 比较 GPU 的算力与带宽屋顶线，调整 GEMM、Batched GEMM 和 Attention 参数，观察算术强度与理论性能上限。
summary_en: Compare GPU compute and bandwidth ceilings, adjust GEMM, batched GEMM, and attention shapes, and explore arithmetic intensity and theoretical performance bounds.

title: HTTP 代理与应用配置
summary: HTTP 转发与 CONNECT、macOS 和 Electron 的代理配置、内网代理与 VPN 协作、源站可见性及 Tinyproxy 部署。
summary_en: HTTP forwarding and CONNECT, macOS and Electron proxy configuration, private proxies over VPNs, origin visibility and Tinyproxy deployment.

title: SSH 转发与隧道
summary: SSH 本地、动态与远程转发的原理和配置，反向隧道与后台运行，以及 HTTP、SOCKS 和 VPN 的组合路径。
summary_en: Local, dynamic and remote SSH forwarding, reverse tunnels and background operation, with HTTP, SOCKS and VPN combinations.

title: VPN 与多重代理选路
summary: macOS 上 VPN、应用内网代理与系统公网代理共存时的五类连接路径，包含交互推演、DNS/UDP 分析与诊断方法。
title_en: Routing with VPNs and multiple proxies
summary_en: Five connection paths with a macOS VPN, private application proxy and public system proxy, with an interactive model, DNS/UDP analysis and diagnostics.

title: VPN 原理与路由
summary: 三层 VPN 的协议封装、隧道地址与路由机制，常见实现的比较，以及 Linux 与 macOS 的 WireGuard 配置教程。
summary_en: Layer-3 VPN encapsulation, addressing and routing, a comparison of common implementations, and a WireGuard setup guide for Linux and macOS.

title: TorchRec Row-wise Sharding
summary: TorchRec 行分片的输入分发、查表、输出恢复与梯度回传；12 张源码关联序列图标明 H2D、主机同步和 AllToAll。
summary_en: TorchRec row-wise input distribution, lookup, output reconstruction and gradient return, with twelve source-linked diagrams marking H2D, host synchronization and AllToAll.

title: TorchRec Sparse Dist Pipeline
summary: 普通与 prefetch sparse dist pipeline 的两阶段通信、context 交接、stream 依赖和缓存条件，配合序列图与交互时间线。
summary_en: Ordinary and prefetch sparse distribution pipelines: two-stage communication, context handoff, stream dependencies and cache requirements, with diagrams and an interactive timeline.

title: CUDA Graph 的 autocast 边界
summary: CUDA Graph 中的 autocast 作用域：backward 的额外 cast、worker cast cache 生命周期及 make_graphed_callables 捕获边界。
summary_en: Autocast boundaries in CUDA Graphs: extra backward casts, worker cast-cache lifetime and backward capture inside make_graphed_callables.

title: DDP AccumulateGrad 的 Stream 绑定
summary: DDP 中 AccumulateGrad 的创建与 stream 绑定、autograd 的执行恢复，以及自定义 stream 和 CUDA Graph 的初始化约束。
summary_en: AccumulateGrad creation and stream binding in DDP, restoration by autograd, and initialization constraints for custom streams and CUDA Graphs.

title: NVIDIA GPU 原子内存顺序
summary: NVIDIA GPU 原子性、release/acquire 与通信作用域，通过数据发布协议和 CUDA/PTX 对照说明正确性条件。
summary_en: NVIDIA GPU atomicity, release/acquire ordering and communication scope, explained through a publication protocol and CUDA/PTX comparisons.

title: AArch64 与 PTX 内联汇编
summary: AArch64 与 CUDA inline PTX 的操作数约束、内存依赖和编译结果，及异步复制、Tensor Core wrapper 的验证方法。
summary_en: Operand constraints, memory dependencies and compiler output for AArch64 and CUDA inline PTX, with validation of asynchronous-copy and Tensor Core wrappers.

title: QuACK RMSNorm：CuTeDSL 源码解析
summary: QuACK RMSNorm 的 213 行 CuTeDSL 源码注释，涵盖 tile 所有权、异步搬运、跨 warp/CTA 规约与融合输出。
summary_en: An annotated 213-line QuACK RMSNorm kernel covering CuTeDSL tile ownership, asynchronous staging, warp/CTA reductions and fused output.

title: GPU 指令发射与延迟隐藏
summary: GPU 指令发射、依赖与 warp 调度的关系，通过 SASS、时间线和 NCU 指标分析延迟隐藏的条件。
title_en: GPU instruction issue and latency hiding
summary_en: GPU instruction issue, dependencies and warp scheduling, with SASS, a timeline and NCU metrics for analyzing latency hiding.

title: GPU 访存路径与 Nsight Compute
summary: Warp 访存合并、sector 粒度及 L1TEX/L2/显存路径，结合布局对照与 NCU 指标分析请求放大、缓存和瓶颈。
title_en: GPU memory paths in Nsight Compute
summary_en: Warp coalescing, sectors and the L1TEX/L2/device-memory path, with layout comparisons and NCU metrics for request amplification, caches and bottlenecks.

title: GPU MIO Throttle 分析
summary: MIO Throttle 的指标含义与诊断方法，结合 shared tile 访问对照分析指令数量、bank conflict 和 kernel 耗时。
summary_en: MIO Throttle interpretation and diagnosis, with shared-tile access comparisons separating instruction count, bank conflicts and kernel time.

title: GPU Scoreboard 与依赖跟踪
summary: GPU Scoreboard 的依赖跟踪、SASS 控制与 warp 等待恢复，以及 Long/Short Scoreboard 的 NCU 采样归因。
summary_en: GPU dependency scoreboarding, SASS controls, warp waiting and resumption, and NCU attribution of Long and Short Scoreboard stalls.

title: Kernel Design Agents 与 KernelWiki
summary: GPU kernel 优化受正确性、可比较测量和目标架构约束，agent 搜索也增加证据管理成本。KDA 固定任务契约并记录候选决策，KernelWiki 提供带版本和来源的知识线索；当前实现仍须由本地 validation、benchmark 与 profile 验证。
summary_en: GPU kernel optimization must satisfy input-domain correctness, comparable measurement, and target-architecture constraints; agent-driven search also increases the cost of evidence management. KDA fixes the task contract and records candidate decisions, while KernelWiki supplies versioned, sourced hypotheses. Local validation, benchmarks, and profiles still determine whether a technique works for the current kernel.

title: CUDA Named Barrier 与 Occupancy
summary: CUDA named barrier 的 ready/reuse 协议、到达计数、代次和 ID 管理，以及同步资源对 block 驻留的约束。
summary_en: CUDA named-barrier ready/reuse protocols, arrival counts, generations and ID management, including synchronization-resource constraints on block residency.

title: Nsight Compute Warp Stall 分析
summary: Nsight Compute warp stall 的分类、采样与归因，结合 Long Scoreboard 案例评估发射空档和实际性能影响。
title_en: Warp stall analysis in Nsight Compute
summary_en: Nsight Compute warp-stall classification, sampling and attribution, with a Long Scoreboard case for evaluating issue gaps and performance impact.

title: GPU Occupancy 与资源约束
summary: 寄存器、shared memory 与 block 大小对 GPU occupancy 的约束，包含 H100 算例、理论与实测值及性能分析。
summary_en: Register, shared-memory and block-size constraints on GPU occupancy, with an H100 example, theoretical and achieved values, and performance analysis.

title: Triton JIT 特化与缓存
summary: Triton JIT 特化键、constexpr、对齐属性及两级缓存，区分编译变体与 autotune，并介绍数量控制和追踪实验。
summary_en: Triton JIT specialization keys, constexpr, alignment and two cache levels, with variant-count controls and experiments distinguishing JIT from autotune.

title: 组相联 Cache 与 LRU 替换
summary: 组相联 Cache 的 set/way 映射、填充和 LRU 替换，采用 256-set、4-way 教学模型分析顺序访问与冲突。
summary_en: Set/way mapping, fills and LRU replacement in a 256-set, four-way teaching model of sequential and conflicting cache accesses.

title: LayerNorm 反向传播与 GPU 实现
summary: LayerNorm 反向含两条正交规约：dX 沿 feature 维，dweight 与 dbias 沿样本行。闭式梯度对应 PyTorch CUDA kernel；Triton 路径融合 dX 与参数梯度 partial sum，再由第二个 kernel 规约 FP32 缓冲区。
summary_en: LayerNorm backward contains two orthogonal reductions: dX reduces across normalized features within each row, whereas dweight and dbias reduce across rows. The closed-form gradients map directly to PyTorch native CUDA kernels; the examined Triton implementation fuses dX with parameter-gradient partial sums and uses a second kernel to reduce FP32 temporary buffers.

title: PyTorch DDP 梯度规约
summary: PyTorch DDP 的 Reducer、bucket 就绪与 AllReduce 触发，及 world-size scaling、梯度累积和 AMP 的影响。
summary_en: PyTorch DDP Reducer buckets, readiness and AllReduce launch, including world-size scaling, gradient accumulation and AMP.

title: PyTorch Autograd 反向图
summary: PyTorch Autograd 的 Node、边与梯度槽位，结合 grad_fn、next_functions、fan-in 和 AccumulateGrad 解释反向执行。
summary_en: PyTorch Autograd nodes, edges and gradient slots, with grad_fn, next_functions, fan-in and AccumulateGrad explaining backward execution.

title: LLM MoE 架构与执行
summary: 现代 sparse MoE 用 top-k 将 token 分配给少量 expert，使模型容量与单 token 计算量分别扩展。运行时还需索引、重排、GroupedGEMM、加权回填和 all-to-all；MegaMoE 改变量化与融合 contract，不改变路由方程。
summary_en: Modern sparse MoE routes each token to a small expert subset, decoupling total parameter capacity from per-token activated compute. Runtime execution still requires token-to-expert indexing, permutation, GroupedGEMM, weighted restoration, and cross-GPU all-to-all; MegaMoE changes the quantization and fusion contract of these stages without changing the routing equation.

title: SiLU 的 tanh 与 exp2 实现
summary: SiLU 的 sigmoid/exp2 与 tanh 实现对比，涵盖 PTX/SASS、特殊函数与依赖链、数值误差和性能验证。
summary_en: SiLU sigmoid/exp2 and tanh implementations compared through PTX/SASS, special functions, dependency chains, numerical error and timing.

title: Codex 会话存储
summary: Codex 分别持久化会话事件、可恢复状态、日志和 memory，因此 ~/.codex 同时包含 rollout JSONL、SQLite 与 WAL。公开接口只保证逻辑职责；state_5.sqlite 等文件名和 schema 属于版本实现，排障与披露应按数据职责判断。
summary_en: Codex persists conversation events, resumable state, diagnostics, and memory as separate concerns, so ~/.codex contains rollout JSONL, SQLite databases, and WAL support files. Public interfaces guarantee these logical responsibilities, not filenames or schemas such as state_5.sqlite; troubleshooting and disclosure decisions should follow data roles rather than extensions.

title: PyTorch Linear 与 cuBLAS 布局
summary: PyTorch Linear 前向与反向 GEMM 的 row-major/column-major 转换、TN/NT/NN 标记及 Hopper FP8 布局约束。
summary_en: Row-major/column-major conversion and TN/NT/NN labels for PyTorch Linear forward and backward GEMMs, including Hopper FP8 layout constraints.

title: FP8 缩放与训练 Recipe
summary: FP8 数值由量化码与 scale 共同定义，recipe 决定粒度和更新策略。MXFP8 沿 GEMM K 轴分块并累加到 FP32；TE v2.16 重新量化 attention 输入，不支持 fp8_mha=True 的 MXFP8 FusedAttention 后端。
summary_en: FP8 values acquire their numerical meaning together with scale metadata; a training recipe fixes the format, scale granularity, amax update, and operator boundaries. MXFP8 places block scales along GEMM reduction axes and accumulates MMA results in FP32, while Transformer Engine v2.16 requantizes Q/K/V at the attention boundary and disables the MXFP8 FusedAttention path when fp8_mha=True.

title: PyTorch record_stream 与显存复用
summary: PyTorch caching allocator 的跨 stream 显存生命周期，record_stream 与 wait_stream 的职责及提前复用风险。
summary_en: Cross-stream memory lifetime in the PyTorch caching allocator, the roles of record_stream and wait_stream, and premature-reuse risks.

title: SWA Packing 与样本隔离
summary: Sequence packing 提高 token 利用率，SWA 只限制层内依赖，不编码样本边界。L 层因果 SWA 的感受野上界为 L(W-1)+1；document mask 或 cu_seqlens 必须切断跨样本路径，保证 packed attention 的样本隔离。
summary_en: Sequence packing improves token utilization, while Sliding Window Attention constrains only local dependencies within each layer and does not encode sample ownership. The maximum theoretical receptive field of L causal SWA layers is L(W-1)+1; document masks or cu_seqlens must disconnect packed samples to preserve attention equivalence with separate execution.

title: AOTInductor CUDA C++ 部署
summary: AOTInductor 离线完成模型捕获、lowering、GPU kernel 生成与 .pt2 打包，再由匹配版本的 libtorch C++ loader 执行。PyTorch v2.12.0 的调用链界定 archive、runner 和 custom op 的双阶段契约；文件名、ELF 依赖及生成符号不属于稳定 ABI。
summary_en: AOTInductor moves model capture, lowering, GPU-kernel generation, and packaging into an offline stage, leaving deployment to execute a .pt2 artifact through a matching libtorch C++ loader. The PyTorch v2.12.0 call path defines the compile-time and runtime contracts for archives, runners, and custom operators, while internal file names, ELF dependencies, and generated symbols remain version-dependent rather than stable ABI.

title: LLM 序列混合机制
summary: LLM 序列混合机制的分类与交互谱系，涵盖 dense/sparse/linear attention、有状态模型、KV 组织和正交结构。
summary_en: An interactive taxonomy of LLM sequence mixing: dense, sparse and linear attention, stateful models, KV organization and orthogonal features.

title: PyTorch 共享库构建与加载
summary: Linux CUDA wheel 把核心类型、CPU/CUDA 算子和 Python binding 分置于多个共享库。v2.12.0 的 CMake target 给出 c10 至 torch_python 的构建层次；实际装载仍由 ELF DT_NEEDED 与 RTLD_GLOBAL 决定，须以安装产物核验。
summary_en: Linux CUDA wheels distribute PyTorch core types, CPU and CUDA operators, and Python bindings across several shared libraries, so import behavior depends on both build topology and ELF dependencies. PyTorch v2.12.0 CMake targets establish the link hierarchy from c10 through torch_python, while final DT_NEEDED entries and RTLD_GLOBAL preload behavior remain properties of the installed artifacts.

title: Hopper Thread Block Cluster
summary: Hopper Thread Block Cluster 将若干 CTA 共调度到同一 GPC，并以 barrier、DSMEM 与 mbarrier/TMA 状态实现跨 CTA 协作。CUDA 12.6.3 和 PTX ISA 8.5 规定可观察语义，资源分派与物理路由不在公开保证内。
summary_en: Hopper Thread Block Clusters co-schedule several CTAs on one GPC and provide cluster-scope barriers, DSMEM addressing, and mbarrier/TMA completion state for cross-CTA protocols. CUDA 12.6.3 and PTX ISA 8.5 define shape, launch, synchronization, and address semantics, while resource allocation and physical routing remain outside the public contract.

title: Context Parallel 通信机制
summary: Context Parallel 将长序列沿 token 维分布到多个 rank，全局 attention 仍需恢复完整 K/V。统一模型给出 AllGather、Ring、Ulysses 与二维方案的通信扩展边界，并区分 head 整除、因果负载和拓扑相关条件。
summary_en: Context parallelism distributes one long sequence across ranks while global attention still requires the complete K/V context. A common communication-compute model exposes the scaling limits of AllGather, Ring, Ulysses, and two-dimensional schemes, separating head-divisibility and causal-load constraints from topology-dependent performance choices.

title: PyTorch Dispatcher 机制
summary: PyTorch Dispatcher 的 schema、DispatchKey、注册与 redispatch，结合 torchgen 和 aten::add 的 CUDA 执行路径。
summary_en: PyTorch dispatcher schemas, dispatch keys, registration and redispatch, with torchgen and the CUDA execution paths of aten::add.

title: PyTorch TorchDispatchMode
summary: Python handler 可借 TorchDispatchMode 改写 ATen 语义，并继续进入 dispatcher。v2.12.0 的 Python key、PyInterpreterVTable 与 mode 暂存构成可重入回路，也划定 mode、tensor subclass 及无 CPython 进程的适用范围。
summary_en: TorchDispatchMode lets FakeTensor, proxy tracing, and distributed tensors override ATen semantics in Python while retaining the C++ dispatcher's priority and redispatch rules. In PyTorch v2.12.0, the Python key, PyInterpreterVTable, PyObjectSlot, and mode stashing form a re-entrant C++/Python loop whose boundaries differ for modes, tensor subclasses, and processes without CPython.

title: OneTrans 与 YaMBDA 数据处理
summary: OneTrans 将 YaMBDA 事件变为 ScoringPair：行为历史经 KJT 和 embedding lookup 生成 S-token，非序列特征组成 NS-token。Shape 推导表明序列长度主导三张 native 表查询，NS-token 在金字塔裁剪中始终保留。
summary_en: OneTrans converts YaMBDA events into target-event ScoringPairs. Behavior histories pass through KJT assembly and embedding lookup to form S-tokens, while scalar embeddings and dense features form NS-tokens. Shape derivations at the pinned commit show that sequence length dominates lookups to the three native embedding tables and that NS-tokens survive every pyramid-trimming stage.

title: Python 导入机制
summary: Python 模块与 package 身份、导入缓存和搜索路径，包含绝对/相对导入、namespace package 与常见错误诊断。
summary_en: Python module and package identity, import caches and search paths, with absolute and relative imports, namespace packages and common-error diagnosis.

title: GEMM 计算强度与分块
summary: GEMM 方阵与矩形 tile 的计算强度推导，HBM/L2/shared memory 分层流量模型，以及融合与训练计算的约束。
summary_en: Arithmetic intensity for square and rectangular GEMM tiles, layered HBM/L2/shared-memory traffic models, and constraints in fusion and training.
